title: Release deconflict and handoff checklist + release notes (draft)
content:
Purpose:
This doc is a working draft to deconflict cross-team dependencies, provide a concise preflight and handoff checklist, publish a short rollout calendar for the pilot cohort, and capture a first-pass release notes draft for the upcoming Sept release. The goal is to make the release easy to read for CS/Support/SRE and to give clear rollback/acceptance triggers.

Scope:
- Applies to the 2026-09 runtime + API changes (minor schema tweaks, batching improvements, and a routing policy change).
- Excludes Private on-prem packaging updates (handled in private-deployments).

Owners & Roster:
- Release owner: Marcus Chen (eng-release-engineering) — overall sign-off
- Release lead (day-of): Asha Patel — runbook execution, comms
- SRE on-call: Olivia Ramirez (primary) — infra rollback/mitigation
- Product SME: Samir Kapoor — acceptance for behavior/quality
- CS/Support lead: Jordan Li — customer comms and triage
- Backup contacts: rotation listed in confluence linked artifact

Pre-release readiness checklist (must be green before pilot):
- [ ] Feature flags created and validated (ff:enable-routing-v2)
- [ ] API schema minor-version documented and client compatibility table updated
- [ ] Load test (10% projected peak) run for 3 consecutive hours, no error-rate > 0.5%
- [ ] Perf baseline collected (p50/p95 token latency, per-model) and attached to PR
- [ ] End-to-end smoke tests in staging passing (chat, streaming, embedding paths)
- [ ] Observability dashboards: token-level costs, latent queue length, error taxonomy
- [ ] Alert thresholds set: 5xx >= 0.8% sustained over 5m; p95 latency regression > +40%
- [ ] Rollback playbook drafted and reviewed by SRE + release owner
- [ ] Customer-impact matrix reviewed (list of top 10 customers who require notification)
- [ ] Docs + migration notes in docs repo (link in linked_artifacts)

Handoff procedure (48h -> D-0):
- D-2: Release owner sends deconflict note to #release-coordination with final calendar and calls out any overlapping releases.
- D-1 09:00 PT: dry run runbook (owners step through handoff) — Asha to record notes.
- D-1 17:00 PT: customer comms drafted and approved by Jordan (template below).
- D-0 01:00 UTC: SRE run preflight (infra health, capacity check).
- D-0 02:00 UTC: Pilot rollout start (see calendar). On-call must be present for first 90 minutes.

Pilot rollout calendar (pilot -> ramp):
- 2026-09-01 02:00 UTC — Start pilot cohort (pilot = 5% of traffic, randomized routing)
  - Duration: 2 hours monitor, then expand if green
  - Metrics to watch: error rate, p95 latency, queue length, token cost per request
- 2026-09-01 05:00 UTC — Expand to 20% if pilot green (no thresholds breached)
  - Monitor 60 minutes between steps for sustained stability
- 2026-09-01 08:00 UTC — Expand to 50% (if green)
- 2026-09-01 12:00 UTC — Full rollout (100%) if final criteria met
- Emergency freeze triggers: any sustained 5xx > 1.5% for 10m OR p95 latency +70% for 10m -> immediate halt and rollback to previous routing policy

Acceptance criteria (to promote between stages):
- Error rate (5xx) < 0.8% and not rising for 30m
- p95 token latency change < +30% vs baseline
- No new client-visible schema regressions
- No loss of capacity for Dedicated clusters (throughput within 5% of baseline)

Rollback criteria and plan:
- Immediate rollback if: 5xx > 1.5% sustained for 10m OR repeated customer complaints (2+ unique paying customers reporting data loss within 30m).
- Rollback steps:
  1) Switch routing policy to previous stable variant (automated flag rollback)
  2) If route switch fails, revert deployment via deployment manager to previous image (SRE)
  3) Open incident, page SRE and release lead, and notify CS/Sales with templated message
  4) Post-rollback verification: smoke test critical flows, confirm metrics returned to baseline for 30m

Post-release: immediate 4h window then daily checks for 72h
- 0-4h: Active monitoring and notes captured in the release incident doc
- 4-24h: Customer-facing release notes published and CS followups scheduled
- 24-72h: Quality review with product and SRE, collect telemetry for regression checks
- 7d: Backfill any missed tests and finalize postmortem if incident occurred

Comms templates (short):
- Slack (pre-release): "Heads-up: Rolling runtime changes starting 2026-09-01 02:00 UTC. Pilot 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. On-call: Olivia. Release lead: Asha. Linked plan: <confluence link>. Ping if you see regressions."
- Customer-facing note (post pilot green): "We rolled out a performance and routing update to the Redwood inference runtime. Most customers will see no behavior changes; performance improvements expected for batched workloads. See docs for notes and rollback policy: <docs link>."

Draft release notes (first pass):
- Highlights:
  - Improved batching logic reduces per-token compute for multi-turn chat by up to 18% in typical workloads.
  - New routing policy v2: smarter region/cost routing for lower tail latency in mixed workloads.
  - Minor API schema extension: request.timeout_ms added (backwards compatible).
- Breaking changes: none expected. Clients relying on exact routing affinity may see different region routing; contact support if this matters.
- Migration notes: clients don’t need immediate action; enable request.timeout_ms if you need per-request hard timeouts.

Known issues & mitigations (to call out in release notes if needed):
- During load tests, a small subset of models saw transient p95 spikes when sequence length > 2k. Mitigation: auto-fallback to lower-memory variant enabled for > 90th percentile sequences. Action: monitor "fallback-rate" metric.
- Rare telemetry duplication observed in staging for long-lived streaming sessions (investigating). Workaround: restart streaming session.

Open questions & risks:
- Risk: overlap with scheduled Dedicated capacity maintenance on 2026-09-02 (Ops to confirm capacity windows).
- Question: do we notify top-3 enterprise customers directly prior to pilot? Product/Sales to confirm.

Next steps / signoff checklist:
- [ ] Product sign-off (Samir)
- [ ] SRE sign-off on rollback (Olivia)
- [ ] CS comms template approved (Jordan)
- [ ] Final deconflict message posted to #release-coordination (Marcus)
- [ ] Dry run completed (Asha)

Appendix: quick links
- PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/1023
- Runbook template: confluence:RELEASE-2026-09-plan
- Incident doc (temp): slack-thread linked in linked_artifacts

Notes to reviewers: this is a draft intended to be concise so we can iterate quickly; please call out anything that would block pilot launch or require moving the pilot window.
